meta.title: Public Expenditure Statistical Analyses 2026
meta.table: Table 5.2 Public sector expenditure on services by sub-function, 2021-22 to 2025-26
meta.basis: TES less spending not funded by the taxes modelled

exclusions.name: Interest on funded public sector pension schemes
exclusions.reason: An accounting entry for the growth of funded schemes' liabilities (chiefly the Local Government Pension Scheme), not a payment from taxes. Employers' contributions, which taxes do pay, are already counted in the services they support.

exclusions.name: Public corporations' debt interest
exclusions.reason: Paid by public corporations out of their own income.

exclusions.name: BBC domestic services
exclusions.reason: Paid for by the television licence fee, which the calculator does not model.

exclusions.name: Council housing investment through Housing Revenue Accounts
exclusions.reason: Capital spending by council housing public corporations, funded by rents and borrowing.

exclusions.name: Investment by transport public corporations (mainly Transport for London)
exclusions.reason: Capital spending by public corporations such as Transport for London's trading arm, funded by fares and borrowing. London Underground is railway spending in PESA.

programmes.title: OSCAR II – publishing data from the database: June 2026
programmes.note: Outlays recorded in HM Treasury's OSCAR II database (provisional), excluding depreciation, provisions, loans and income.

categories.name: Welfare and pensions
categories.description: Mainly the Department for Work and Pensions: the State Pension, Universal Credit, and disability, family and housing benefits.

children.name: State Pension and pensioner benefits
children.description: Mostly the State Pension, plus Pension Credit and the Winter Fuel Payment. Public service pensions are counted net of the contributions paid in.

children.name: Disability and incapacity benefits
children.description: Including Personal Independence Payment and Attendance Allowance.

children.name: Compensation schemes and other support
children.description: Includes compensation paid directly to people, such as for infected blood and the Post Office Horizon scandal.

categories.name: Health
categories.description: Mainly the NHS, through the Department of Health and Social Care: hospitals, GPs, community care, public health and medical research.

categories.name: Education
categories.description: The Department for Education and councils: early years, schools, colleges and universities.

children.name: Secondary schools and academies
children.description: Includes all academies, primary ones too, because the Department for Education records all academy spending as secondary.

children.name: Primary schools
children.description: Understated: the Department for Education records all academy spending as secondary.

children.name: School meals, transport and other support
Universities
children.description: Direct spending such as teaching grants. Student loans are not public spending in this measure.

categories.name: Debt interest
categories.description: Interest on government borrowing, paid by the Treasury, and the cost of the Bank of England's quantitative easing. Excludes accounting interest on pension schemes and public corporations' own debt.

children.name: Bank of England quantitative easing
children.description: Losses on the Bank of England's bond-buying, which the Treasury covers in cash under its indemnity.

categories.name: Defence
categories.description: The Ministry of Defence: the armed forces, military aid and defence research.

categories.name: Social care
categories.description: Run by councils: care for older people, disabled adults and children.

categories.name: Policing, justice and borders
categories.description: Mainly the Home Office, the Ministry of Justice and councils: police, immigration and borders, courts, prisons, and fire and rescue.

children.name: Immigration, asylum and borders
children.description: Including asylum support and accommodation, and Border Force.

categories.name: Transport
categories.description: The Department for Transport and councils: railways, roads, buses and other transport. Excludes investment by public corporations such as Transport for London, funded by fares and borrowing.

children.name: Railways (including HS2)
children.description: Includes London Underground, but not investment by public corporations such as Transport for London, which fares and borrowing pay for.

categories.name: Business, energy and science
categories.description: Mainly the departments for business, energy, science and farming: business support, energy, research, broadband and farm payments.

children.name: Business support and employment
children.description: Business support, trade promotion and employment programmes.

children.name: Research and development
children.description: Mostly UK Research and Innovation and other science funding.

notable.name: UK Research and Innovation
notable.note: A small part of UKRI's spending is classed under health, education and environmental research instead.

categories.name: Running government
categories.description: The Cabinet Office, the Treasury, HMRC, the Foreign Office and Parliament: central government, tax collection and diplomacy, plus net payments to the EU.

children.name: Government departments, tax collection and diplomacy
children.description: Parliament, the Cabinet Office, the Treasury, HMRC and the Foreign Office.

children.name: Shared government services
children.description: Central services such as government property and the Office for National Statistics.

children.name: EU payments (net)
children.description: Payments to EU institutions less receipts from them. Negative when receipts are larger.

categories.name: Environment
categories.description: Mainly the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, councils and the Nuclear Decommissioning Authority: waste, pollution control and nature.

notable.name: Nuclear Decommissioning Authority (Sellafield and other sites)

categories.name: Housing and communities
categories.description: The Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government and councils: social housing, community development, street lighting and water. Excludes council housing investment funded by rents and borrowing.

children.name: Council housing
children.description: Excludes council housing investment funded by rents and borrowing through Housing Revenue Accounts.

children.name: Housing associations and other social housing

categories.name: Culture, media and sport
categories.description: The Department for Culture, Media and Sport and councils: museums, libraries, the arts, sport and broadcasting. Excludes the BBC's licence-fee-funded services.

categories.name: Overseas aid
categories.description: Mainly the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office: economic aid to other countries. Not the official development assistance total, which is measured differently; military aid is under Defence.
